messages.content: What have you noticed about how the Moon looks on different nights?
I never learned moon phases. Why does it change shape?
What do you think could make the bright part change?
Could Earth's shadow be covering different parts?
If that were true, would the shadow change as the Moon travels around Earth?
I still don't know. Just explain it.
The Sun always lights half of the Moon. As the Moon moves around Earth, we see different amounts of that lit half; those views are the phases.
Oh, so the Moon stays round and we just see different amounts of its sunny half.
Exactly: the Moon stays round, and its changing position changes how much of the lit half we see. You explained the key idea, so this part is done.
